source_semantics.review: Individually review all five complete files and eight hunks of the chip-form/example commit, including its unrelated tooltip timing hunk. Reactive example keywords now come from one non-null FormControl initialized with all four values instead of a separate signal plus a one-value control; add/remove call setValue and removal deliberately uses lastIndexOf, changing duplicate-removal semantics. Template-driven content renames its keyword signal/handlers, makes announcer private and reorganizes add/remove while preserving its signal update path. Both templates change bindings/handlers, and clear no longer uses a redundant non-null assertion on chipInput. These are real example/form/API/announcement changes, not a mechanical rename and not a reason to replace legacy MatChipList markup with modern grid/row components. The tooltip case changes async waits250/600 plus whenStable to fakeAsync ticks250/500 plus flush. The exact complete tooltip file is unchanged outside that one captured case; all74 source identities remain and73 complete callbacks are unchanged. Do not assert scheduler/error/lifetime equivalence for the changed callback. The owned legacy event already requires chipInput, and its retained tooltip case already uses fakeAsync ticks250/500, historical assertions and explicit owned animation completion. Preserve that case, existing legacy forms/CVA, styles and the Cyph mat-chip-list/formControl structure. No owned product, test callback, consumer TS/API, HTML, CSS or SCSS change is required; actual reactive form/native tooltip/floor execution remains open.
